Iowa Salvage Grain Company
Located in the heart of Iowa, Pruess Elevator is the leading provider of salvaged grain services for farmers across the state. When unforeseen circumstances damage your crops, we understand the frustration and financial impact it can have on your livelihood. That’s why we are here to help you recover the value of your grain.
With our extensive experience and state-of-the-art facilities, we specialize in salvaging damaged grain and maximizing its potential. Our team of experts is well-versed in identifying salvageable grain, separating it from unusable portions, and ensuring that you receive the best possible return for your hard work.
At Pruess Elevator, we take pride in offering personalized service tailored to meet your specific needs. We work closely with farmers, understanding the unique challenges they face, and providing efficient, reliable solutions. Our dedicated staff utilizes industry-leading techniques to handle your grain with the utmost care and precision.
Whether it’s due to weather-related events or other causes, we are equipped to salvage grain of various types and sizes. From corn and soybeans to wheat and oats, we have the expertise and equipment to rescue as much value as possible from your damaged crop.
Partnering with Pruess Elevator means you can trust us to navigate the complexities of salvaging grain in Iowa. We are committed to helping you recoup losses, minimize waste, and maximize your returns. With our top-notch facilities and unwavering dedication to customer satisfaction, we ensure a seamless and efficient process from start to finish.
Don’t let damaged grain hold you back. Contact Pruess Elevator today and let us put our expertise to work for you. Together, we’ll turn adversity into opportunity and help your farming business thrive once again.
Pruess Elevator
We extract and merchandise virtually any damaged grain from farm bins, elevators, silos, spills and barges.
